notes: The doubled אִישׁ אִישׁ is split between any and man's rather than fused: the ASV spends a word on each, so rule 30's one-English-word condition is unmet and rule 2 splits it. The suffix on אִשְׁתּוֹ is unrepresented, the possessor being written once inside man's; the competing division is named in that unit's note.
